study_identification.author_journal_year: Pinaya et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2019
study_identification.title: Using deep autoencoders to identify abnormal brain structural patterns in neuropsychiatric disorders: A large-scale multi-sample study

study_characteristics.study_objective: Train a deep autoencoder on healthy structural MRI to build a normative model and quantify total/regional neuroanatomical deviations in individual patients with schizophrenia and autism; compare deviation-based results to traditional classifiers and identify altered regions.

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Group comparisons using Mann–Whitney U tests on deviation metrics (patients vs controls) with Cliff’s delta; compared to linear SVM classification (reported AUC-ROC and CIs).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: The autoencoder-based normative model trained on HCP produced higher deviation scores in SCZ and ASD than in matched controls and revealed disorder-specific regional deviation patterns, with performance comparable to a linear SVM.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: NUSDAST: mean deviation 1.14±0.28 (SCZ) vs 0.97±0.23 (HC), Cliff’s δ=0.4142, p=.001. ABIDE: 1.27±0.40 (ASD) vs 1.09±0.30 (HC), Cliff’s δ=0.2764, p<.001. Classifier comparison: NUSDAST SVM AUC-ROC=0.637 (95% CI [0.486,0.766]) vs normative AUC-ROC=0.707 (95% CI [0.662,0.751]); ABIDE SVM AUC-ROC=0.569 (95% CI [0.462,0.659]) vs normative AUC-ROC=0.639 (95% CI [0.611,0.666]). Regional analyses identified significant reconstruction error differences (e.g., NUSDAST: left ventral diencephalon, lateral ventricles, precentral; ABIDE: left choroid plexus, right cuneus, left putamen, left cerebellum cortex).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Potential motion-related artifacts not explicitly modeled; no additional visual QC corrections applied; no explicit harmonization for site/scanner effects; DL approach does not indicate directionality of alterations when comparing groups from different datasets; moderate classification performance.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Semi-supervised architecture jointly reconstructs ROIs and predicts age/sex; denoising training with Gaussian noise and L2 regularization; architecture 104-100-75-100-104 selected via 10-fold CV on HCP.

general_notes.general_notes: Training: 2,000 epochs; Adam with decaying LR (0.05→0.0005); mini-batch size 64; SELU activations with appropriate initialization; zero-mean unit-variance normalization parameters learned on HCP and applied to test sets. No explicit site harmonization; within-dataset comparisons used to mitigate site confounds. Total features: 104 (68 CT + 36 volumes).
